title: 第九章 想闹事那就横着出去新书求月票第十章 幽月裂骨
slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: 楼梯上。
瘫软的女人怔怔抬头，泪眼朦胧的朝近处看去。
已经心绪崩溃的她比任何人都期待着转机。
但映入女人眼帘的，却只有张辞那张阴冷的侧脸，以及对方微微鼓动的太阳穴。
很显然，这位鸿运武馆少东家并没有退步的意思，反而已经来到了暴怒的边缘。
“你他妈是不是没脑子？”
张辞原本的雅兴一扫而空。
黑水帮再势大，对方也不过是头臭狐狸。
甚至鸿运武馆本身就是不少狡狐堂成员的人脉之一。
平常吓唬吓唬老百姓还成，唬到自己这个少东家身上来了？！
伴随着骂声，张辞眸光森寒，抡动右臂，手掌直直的朝着那男人扇去。
簌簌——
破风声乍响，一记凶狠巴掌提前落到了张辞脸上，打断了他的叫骂。
张辞都没看清对方的动作，便感觉巨力袭来，近乎压塌自己的颧骨。
他喷出血沫，身形刚刚弯下去，那只手掌已经熟稔攥住了他的头发。
砰！砰！砰！
林舒抓住他的脑袋，猛地朝桌上砸去。
厚实的木桌剧烈震动，和桌面一起开裂的，还有张辞的鼻梁。
这套行云流水的动作足足持续了十几息。
张辞大脑发懵，满脸剧痛。
待到他反应过来时，整个人都被狠狠压在了桌上，后脑上有力按下的五指，更是让他连抬头都成了奢望。
林舒俯下身子，扯着这小少爷的头发，露出那张布满血浆的脸庞。
四目相对
他仔细的用拇指帮对方擦去眼角的血渍，淡淡道：“现在能听懂人话了吗？”
张辞脸皮剧烈抽搐，眼珠外鼓。
他眼角余光能看见周围的那群婊子。
这突如其来的变故，让屋内所有姑娘都被吓傻在原地。
她们大气不敢出，眸光呆滞的盯着两人。
这些不加遮掩的注视，再加脸上的伤口，张辞只觉得面皮火辣辣的疼。
他最享受的就是这群野鸡恐惧却无处可逃的样子。
但现在，自己却成了她们看戏的对象。
张辞喉头急速滚动，瞳孔里涌现几分癫狂。
这时，他却感受到了眼角处的拇指，正在渐渐发力，仿佛要碾碎自己的眼眶。
“能……能听懂。”
content_en:
;;
On the stairs.
The limp woman raised her head and looked closer with tears in her eyes.
Already emotionally broken, she was looking forward to a turnaround more than anyone else.
But what caught the woman's eyes were Zhang Ci's cold side face and his slightly twitching temples.
Obviously, the young master of Hongyun Martial Arts School has no intention of retreating, but has reached the edge of rage.
"Are you fucking brainless?"
Zhang Ci's original elegance was completely wiped out.
No matter how powerful the Blackwater Gang is, the opponent is just a stinky fox.
Even Hongyun Martial Arts School itself is one of the connections of many Cunning Fox Hall members.
Normally, it's okay to scare the common people, but now he's trying to scare his young boss? !
"Fuck you..."
Along with the curse, Zhang Ci's eyes were cold, he swung his right arm and slapped the man straight with his palm.
Susu——
The sound of breaking wind suddenly sounded, and a fierce slap fell on Zhang Ci's face in advance, interrupting his yelling.
"Pfft."
Zhang Ci didn't even see the other party's movements clearly before he felt a huge force coming, almost crushing his cheekbones.
He spurted out blood foam, and just as he bent down, that hand had already grasped his hair familiarly.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Lin Shu grabbed his head and slammed it on the table.
The thick wooden table shook violently, and the bridge of Zhang Ci's nose cracked along with the tabletop.
This set of flowing movements lasted for more than ten breaths.
Zhang Ci was confused and his face was in severe pain.
When he reacted, his whole body was pressed hard on the table, and the five fingers pressing hard on the back of his head made it impossible for him to even raise his head.
"..."
Lin Shu leaned down and pulled the young master's hair, revealing his face covered in blood.
Eye to eye
He carefully wiped the blood from the corner of the other person's eyes with his thumb, and said calmly: "Can you understand people now?"
Zhang Ci's face twitched violently and his eyes bulged.
Out of the corner of his eye he could see the group of bitches surrounding him.
This sudden change caused all the girls in the room to freeze in place.
They didn't dare to express their anger and stared at the two of them with dull eyes.
These undisguised gazes, coupled with the wounds on his face, made Zhang Ci feel burning pain on his face.
What he enjoyed most was the way these pheasants looked scared but had nowhere to escape.
But now, he has become the object of their drama.
"Ho!"
Zhang Ci's throat rolled rapidly, and a bit of madness appeared in his pupils.
At this time, he felt the thumb at the corner of his eye gradually exerting force, as if it was going to crush his eye socket.
"Can...can understand."
